description: BRATIXLAB is a technology and innovation team focused on software development, AI, blockchain, and emerging technologies. For NASA Space Apps Challenge 2026, we aim to develop practical solutions for astronaut health monitoring. We welcome passionate developers, AI and data science enthusiasts, UI/UX designers, researchers, biomedical experts, and problem-solvers. We value creativity, teamwork, commitment, and a willingness to learn. Join us to turn ideas into impact!
